class.name: IfcVertexLoop
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A vertex_loop is a loop of zero genus consisting of a single vertex. A vertex can exist independently of a vertex loop. The topological data shall satisfy the following constraint: Informal propositions: A vertex loop has zero extent and dimensionality. The vertex loop has genus 0. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: vertex_loop. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303

members.member: The vertex which defines the entire loop.
